today_summary: GCM26 marks $4,140.6, down $46.4 on the session and sitting at the bottom of a 61-point 5-day range. The chain stays structurally call-heavy at 0.39 P/C OI, but today's tape disagrees: put volume 4,169 vs call volume 4,855 is a 0.859 P/C volume ratio, the highest of the week. Net GEX within +/-$200 of spot is -258 (put GEX -437 against call GEX +180), placing price in a short-gamma pocket $709 below the 4,850 gamma flip. ATM IV 20.76% puts the 1-sigma daily move at $54.15 (1.31%).
five_day_thesis: Spot has gone almost nowhere in five sessions, $4,202.2 to $4,140.6 (-1.47%) inside a 1.5% range, while the option structure underneath it quietly thinned. Net GEX across the +/-20% window decayed from +203.6 to +65.9, a 68% collapse in the dealer cushion that was damping every move last Friday. The decisive change is flow rotation rather than structure: put volume rose 55% from 2,684 to 4,169 while call volume fell 37% from 7,709 to 4,855, lifting P/C volume from 0.348 to 0.859 and quadrupling Monday's 0.215 reading. Open interest still disagrees with that flow, with call OI building +9,218 (+4.0%) against put OI +2,047 (+2.2%), so the upside carry is slow money while the hedging bid is today's money. ATM IV is -0.63pp on the week at 20.76% but ticked +0.31pp on the last session, the first uptick alongside the put bid and the cleanest early warning in the series.

prediction: Bias neutral to lower while $4,187 caps the tape. With 1-sigma at $54 the base case is continued $4,100-$4,190 chop, but the -258 local GEX means a loss of $4,100 extends rather than mean-reverts, with $4,000 (4,566 put OI) the first genuine demand shelf and $3,900 (4,395 OI) behind it. Max pain $5,495 sits 32% overhead on legacy call OI and exerts no pinning force at 48 DTE - treat it as structure, not a target.
